title: Mastercard Expands Cyber Defense With $2.65B Deal For Recorded Future - What's On The Cards?
description: Mastercard announced the acquisition of Recorded Future, a global threat intelligence company, for $2.65 billion. The acquisition will enhance Mastercard's cybersecurity services and leverage AI to boost fraud prevention, decision-making, and threat detection for payments and beyond.

title: Mastercard's Cybersecurity Expansion: Analysts Highlight Synergies And Positive Revenue Impact By 2025
description: Mastercard announced the acquisition of Recorded Future for $2.65 billion, enhancing its cybersecurity services. Analysts see strong synergies and a potential 1ppt revenue boost for Mastercard by 2025.

title: Mastercard Brings Same-Day Payouts To South African Merchants: Details
description: Mastercard is launching same-day card payments in South Africa, enabling faster clearing and settlement for merchants. This initiative supports financial inclusion and aligns with the South African Reserve Bank's Vision 2025.
